record.question: Which of the following is an important requirement when selecting a packaging material for a drug?
options: The material must be inert and protective.
The material must match the colour of the drug.
Biodegradable materials should always be preferred
The materials should follow the colour code as per Indian Pharmacy council.
record.explanation: Answer A: The material must be inert and protective.. A drug package must be compatible/inert with respect to the product and provide suitable protection against contamination, moisture, light, and handling. Reference: https://www.fda.gov/drugs/pharmaceutical-quality-resources/container-closure-systems-packaging-human-drugs-and-biologics. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
